help.message: Represents a Task in a single system. Tasks must be populated with Capabilities.

events.info: Called to abort the task when it is running
Emitted when the task is completed successfully
Emitted when the task is completed unsuccessfully

help.message: Minimum level before the battery needs to be charged
Start of a behavioural flow. This can be a reaction to an event or a timed action
End of a happy behavioural flow. This must always be present in a flow
End of an errored behavioural flow. This indicates the flow of a bad behaviour.
Used with signal handlers to indicate that the main behaviour should continue executing after the signal was handled.
End of a task. This will end the current task, independent of where it is triggered.
Performs the "do" strategy and if it does not conclude within the set time, it will trigger the "else" strategy.

properties.info: Number of times the loop will execute. A value of 0 repeats indefinitely until the flow is stopped or aborted.
Delay in milliseconds between consecutive iterations. For example, a value of 1000 executes the loop once per second.

help.message: Executes the contained strategy repeatedly. Configure the number of iterations and the interval between executions using the block properties.
